resources.string: Signing
Configure default signing algorithms, signature level, and globally disabled algorithms.
Defaults
Default hash algorithm, encryption algorithm, and PAdES signature level used when no profile override is active.
Disabled Algorithms
Algorithms disabled here cannot be selected at any level — profiles and operations that reference a disabled algorithm are rejected during config resolution.
Services
Configure connections to external services used during signing and validation.
Timestamp Server
RFC 3161 Timestamp Authority used to add trusted timestamps to signatures (required for B-T and above).
OCSP & CRL
Connection timeouts for Online Certificate Status Protocol and Certificate Revocation List requests.
Validation
Configure document validation policy, trust sources, and algorithm constraint handling.
Policy & Trust
Validation policy source, certificate revocation checking, and EU List of Trusted Lists integration.
Algorithm Constraints
Control how the validator reacts when a cryptographic algorithm has passed its expiration date.
Trusted Certificates

Directly trusted CA and TSA certificates for the global scope, backed by the app-managed trust store and wired into DSS alongside any ETSI trusted lists without requiring an XML document. Additions and removals are staged and committed when you save. Profile-specific certificates are managed in the profile editor; the Trusted Certificates side panel shows a read-only overview.
Trusted Lists

Register external ETSI TS 119612 Trusted List XML sources. Each entry may be an HTTPS URL or a local file path. An optional signing certificate verifies the TL's XML signature — strongly recommended for non-EU lists.
Archiving
Configure automatic archival renewal of B-LTA documents.
Renewal Jobs
Named jobs that automatically re-timestamp B-LTA PDFs when their archival timestamp nears expiry. Each job defines glob patterns for the files to watch and a renewal buffer in days.
Scheduler
Configure the OS-level daily scheduler that runs renewal jobs automatically via systemd (Linux), launchd (macOS), or Task Scheduler (Windows).
Tokens
Configure hardware token and smart card middleware discovery.
PKCS#11 Libraries
Register custom PKCS#11 middleware libraries that are not discovered automatically by the OS.
Backup
Export the full configuration to a ZIP archive, or import one to replace it.
Import & Export
Export the entire configuration — global settings, every profile, and all trusted certificates — to a single ZIP archive, or import an archive to replace the current configuration.
Appearance
Desktop appearance and window decoration settings.
Window
Choose whether the toolbar is merged into the title bar area (custom CSD) or displayed below the native OS title bar. Changing this setting requires an application restart.
Language & Region
Choose the application language and how dates are displayed.
Language & Region
Pick a region preset to set the language and date format together, or choose each independently. Changes preview live, take effect when you save, and revert if you close without saving.
